rationale: Optimized dispatch to maximize critical load energy served while respecting reserve SOC constraints. EV A has 8kWh usable above reserve (24-16), EV B has 8kWh (20-12). Used discrete step sizes (4kW for A, 3kW for B) to approximate optimal schedule: t1 uses max discharge to serve 12.6kW, t2 reduces to preserve SOC, t3 uses remaining available energy. Final SOCs exactly at or above reserve limits.
